decision: Selected one retry owner at the dependency adapter, absolute operation deadlines, end-to-end cancellation, authoritative-empty semantics, bounded crash recovery, and startup recovery independent of durable stores

why: Nested retries multiplied wait time and made cancellation dishonest

decision: Separated authoritative empty results from failed and partial provider reads
why: An outage previously looked like a user with no follows or categories

decision: Added runtime schemas for third-party emote responses and bounded all three provider reads
why: Malformed or oversized provider data could reach transforms and requests had no shared deadline

decision: Added app, route, and regional React recovery boundaries plus bounded Electron renderer crash recovery
why: A component or renderer crash could leave a permanently blank window or reload loop
result: VERIFIED by focused component and main-process tests

decision: Made SQLite startup integrity-checked, backed up, and transactionally migrated; added a store-independent recovery window
why: A corrupt store or half-applied schema migration could make every launch disappear
result: VERIFIED by database suite, startup recovery test, typecheck

decision: Raised the legacy IPC node budget while retaining hard string/binary/depth caps
